ge_kappa.description: Generalized-endpoint additive q/pT bias in DATA relative to MC (q/pT_meas = q/pT_true + kappa), TuneP pT; corrected on data above the threshold as q/pT -> q/pT - kappa (the Run 3 recommendation of the [POG] page: apply the GE biases as a correction).
ge_kappa.source: [POG] High pT: Momentum Scale, Run 3 tab, '2022 postEE kappa_b maps in (phi, eta)'.
ge_kappa.layout: kappa[i][j]: i = eta bin (ascending, signed eta), j = phi bin (ascending from -pi). On the [POG] page the rows are the phi bins (-180 to -60, -60 to 60, 60 to 180 degrees) and the columns the eta bins; the uncertainty is the number in parentheses.

mc_smearing.description: MC p -> p * (1 + N(0, sigma(p, |eta|) * f)), f = sqrt((1 + x)^2 - 1), above the threshold. Nominal x = extra_smear (barrel |eta| < eta_split, endcap above); MuSmear up/down use x = extra_smear +- syst.
mc_smearing.sigma_source: [POG] High pT: Momentum Resolution, Run 3 tab, '2022 postEE': the two sigma(p, eta) formulas.
mc_smearing.extra_smear_source: [POG] High pT: Momentum Resolution, Run 3 tab, '2022 postEE': the width factor 0.32 (0.46) for central (forward) muons, f = sqrt((1 + x)^2 - 1).
mc_smearing.syst_source: [POG] High pT: Momentum Resolution: a 10 % shift for barrel and endcap muons, all data-taking periods.
mc_smearing.sigma_p_max_note: Above 2.5 TeV sigma is held at its 2.5 TeV value (our choice, as for 2024; the cubic grows quickly beyond the momenta of the Z-based fits).
